cohort: The cohort consisted of 875 adult females aged 18 and above attending Primary Healthcare Centers in Bahrain.
finding: The study found a 24.8% prevalence of UI among adult females attending PHCCs in Bahrain, with stress incontinence as the most common type, and identified several risk factors including widowhood, retired status, multiple pregnancies, urogenital infection, non-C-section surgery, and constipation.
